description:
Get historical crypto prices over a 1–365 day window: period statistics (start, end, % change, high, low), a downsampled daily series, high_30d, std_30d, and dca_baseline_90d. Use for period comparisons and trend analysis; prefer over web_search for time-comparative financial queries. Pass stats_only=true when the daily series is unnecessary.

Use when: Use for time-comparative financial questions — month-over-month, YTD, volatility, or DCA baselines. Prefer over web_search for such queries. Use the pre-computed stats directly; do not re-derive them with calculate.

Limitations: Daily granularity (downsampled), max 365-day window, CoinGecko coverage only. Check dca_baseline_90d_partial before relying on the baseline — incomplete history yields a partial baseline.

Alternatives: get_token_price, web_search

stats_only.description: If true, omit the daily price series and return period stats plus precomputed 30-day high/volatility and 90-day DCA baseline metrics.
stats_only.title: Stats Only

tokens.description: Token symbols or CoinGecko IDs (e.g. ['BTC', 'ETH']). Max 10 per call.
tokens.title: Tokens

vs_currency.description: Quote currency (usd, eur, gbp, btc, eth). Lowercase 3–10 letters.
vs_currency.title: Vs Currency

name: get_token_price_historical

dca_baseline_90d.description: Mean of weekly daily-close samples from the preceding 90 UTC days, in vs_currency.
dca_baseline_90d.title: Dca Baseline 90D

dca_baseline_90d_partial.description: True when the DCA baseline uses incomplete 90-day history; null when unavailable.
dca_baseline_90d_partial.title: Dca Baseline 90D Partial

high_30d.description: Maximum raw price observation in the trailing 30 UTC days, in vs_currency.
high_30d.title: High 30D

std_30d.description: Population standard deviation of trailing 30-day simple daily returns, as a decimal.
std_30d.title: Std 30D

title: Get Token Price Historical
